theme_tracking_defects.evidence: layout/theme.liquid initializes window.dataLayer and assets/analytics.js only; ops/customer-events/ga4-checkout-ecommerce-pixel.js is a deprecation stub. Public home showed gtag_js_hits=0, gtm_hits=0, google_ads_hits=8, shopify_web_pixel_hits=5.
theme_tracking_defects.profit_or_feed_impact: Paid ROAS/CAC cannot be trusted until Google & YouTube app / ad-platform conversion settings are verified outside the theme.
theme_tracking_defects.recommended_fix_plan: Export/verify Google Ads conversion actions and Shopify Google & YouTube app status before any paid scaling.
theme_tracking_defects.rollback_method: No code rollback needed for audit; do not add duplicate GTM/gtag scripts.

theme_tracking_defects.evidence: snippets/jsonld-seo.liquid hardcodes handlingTime 2 days and transitTime 7-10 days; live shipping policy says processing 1-3 business days, US 7-15, CA/UK 10-20, AU 12-25.
theme_tracking_defects.profit_or_feed_impact: Structured-data shipping promises can conflict with actual policy and paid landing-page expectations.
theme_tracking_defects.recommended_fix_plan: Dry-run schema update to align JSON-LD delivery windows with policy/market-specific shipping settings.
theme_tracking_defects.rollback_method: Revert snippet change or restore previous jsonld-seo.liquid from git.

theme_tracking_defects.evidence: templates/product.json has Judge.me preview_badge and review_widget app blocks; sections/main-product.liquid also has native rating block. Public sample PDP has no_reviews_hits=1 and customer_photo_reviews_hits=3.
theme_tracking_defects.profit_or_feed_impact: Review trust can look inconsistent if app badge says no reviews while custom headings/prompts are shown.
theme_tracking_defects.recommended_fix_plan: Visually verify PDP review states and make one source of truth for empty state, badge, review widget, and schema rating.
theme_tracking_defects.rollback_method: Disable/revert only the selected review block/settings change after screenshot comparison.

theme_tracking_defects.evidence: Public Spanish PDP has translation_missing_hits=1; observed footer key text includes Translation missing for customer care heading.
theme_tracking_defects.profit_or_feed_impact: Paid non-English traffic can land on visibly broken localized pages.
theme_tracking_defects.recommended_fix_plan: Fix live theme/section translation source for Spanish footer/customer-care heading before paid ES traffic.
theme_tracking_defects.rollback_method: Restore previous locale/section setting or remove paid language targeting.

theme_tracking_defects.evidence: Public pages expose about 304 country option markers; Shopify export shows 6 active markets, 21 published languages, and shipping zones include named Epacket countries plus Rest of world wildcard.
theme_tracking_defects.profit_or_feed_impact: Large country/currency selector can imply full readiness across countries where shipping speed/returns expectations may be weaker.
theme_tracking_defects.recommended_fix_plan: Create paid-country allowlist until shipping promises, policy copy, and localization are validated by country.
theme_tracking_defects.rollback_method: Revert paid location targeting; no theme rollback needed unless selector settings are changed.

theme_tracking_defects.evidence: Public page HTML sizes: home=888550 bytes, collection all=1613964 bytes, sample PDP=930305 bytes; Judge.me app embed active in config/settings_data.json.
theme_tracking_defects.profit_or_feed_impact: Large HTML/app payloads can depress conversion rate and paid landing-page quality.
theme_tracking_defects.recommended_fix_plan: Profile app embeds, country selector payload, and review scripts before paid scale.
theme_tracking_defects.rollback_method: Disable reverted app embed/settings changes if conversion or reviews regress.
